## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, stolid youth of twenty. He has a round, expressionless face and suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

A big, round-faced youth, Billy Andrews is a stolid, good-natured, and perpetually smiling individual who lacks conversational gifts and is quite shy. Despite being considered stupid, he is a dependable and great worker who possesses no bad habits.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## History

Billy Andrews's father eventually gave him the upper farm in his own name. Earlier, Billy joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on a drive to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performed at a benefit concert. Following her successful recitation, he accompanied the group on the drive home while they discussed wealth, luxury, and their personal contentment.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P33](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

### [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--nettie-blewett.md)

Billy is romantically interested in [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) and considers pursuing marriage with her as an alternative if [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses his proposal. Reports conflict on whether the two are actually married, though his romantic interest in her is established.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
